title: Finite-clopen detection at one positive integral quotient
statement: Let P be a purity finite setting, X a quasi-compact locally finite-type scheme over P.field.k, and (j_i:X_i → X) a finite disjoint covering by open and closed immersions, allowing the index type or components to be empty. For every completed-integral derived object K and each n≥0, intrinsic finite torsion constructibility of its reduction at exponent n+1 is equivalent to constructibility of the n-th reductions of its ordinary completed restrictions. Support in any fixed ordered interval [a,b], and pro-etale Tor amplitude in any fixed ordered interval [a,b], are likewise equivalent to the same assertion for every component at this one exponent. Use the reduction, constructibility, support and Tor definitions of the cited statement dependencies. No completeness assertion and no bound uniform in n is asserted. The ordinary completed restriction is the construction of [def-pur-clopen-integral-restriction].

source.place: Definition 3.5.2 and Proposition 3.5.1(1), p. 24; finite-clopen application, augmented integral descent steps 2 and 5; Stacks Tags 06YY, 00XZ and 03CO.

proof.text: Replace P.level by n+1 and apply lem-pur-clopen-finite-constructibility-bounds to the global derived reduction. Its ordinary constant-coefficient pullbacks identify with the reductions of the ordinary completed restrictions by lem-pur-integral-reduction-clopen-comparison. Transport the cohomology constructibility and support tests along the homology isomorphisms. The Tor predicate is invariant under isomorphism, since its resolution tests are specified up to isomorphism. This gives the two same-interval equivalences.

Intrinsic finite torsion constructibility is finite cohomological support and constructible cohomology in every degree. The cohomology equivalence is already obtained. In the forward direction enclose the finite global support in an ordered integer interval and restrict. Conversely take the finite union of the finite component supports, enclose it in an ordered interval, and use same-interval detection to bound the global support by that finite interval. The union over an empty index is empty, so this argument also covers an empty partition without taking its minimum.

theorem integralReductionFiniteClopenBounds
    (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of P.field.k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    {I : Type w} [Finite I]
    (Xi : I → Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of P.field.k))) (j : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X)
    [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i).left] [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (j i).left]
    (hdisjoint : ∀ i i', i ≠ i' →
      Disjoint (Set.range (j i).left) (Set.range (j i').left))
    (hcover : (⋃ i, Set.range (j i).left) = Set.univ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible P.coefficients.l P.extension (n + 1)
        (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)) X.left
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left n).obj K) ↔
      ∀ i, intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible P.coefficients.l P.extension (n + 1)
        (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)) (Xi i).left
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension P.coefficients.l P.extension (Xi i).left n).obj
          ((clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension (j i).left).obj K))) ∧
    (∀ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b →
      (proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left n).obj K) ⊆
            Set.Icc a b ↔
        ∀ i, proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension P.coefficients.l P.extension (Xi i).left n).obj
            ((clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension (j i).left).obj K)) ⊆
              Set.Icc a b)) ∧
    (∀ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b →
      (HasProEtaleTorAmplitude X.left
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing P.coefficients.l P.extension (n + 1))
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left n).obj K) a b ↔
        ∀ i, HasProEtaleTorAmplitude (Xi i).left
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing P.coefficients.l P.extension (n + 1))
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension P.coefficients.l P.extension (Xi i).left n).obj
            ((clopenIntegralDerivedRestriction P.coefficients.l P.extension (j i).left).obj K))
          a b))
